validity.researcher_notes: DUPLICATE QUESTION (P7332 vs P7337, both 'Suez-Musturad', both 134 km, 12in vs 18in) — RESOLVED AS NOT A DUPLICATE. Fetched the sole harvested wiki citation, petro-news.com/11234/ (a PPC/Petroleum Pipelines Co. company-profile article, published 2021-08-12, still live): it states PPC has operated since 1955 'through the Suez/Musturad line, diameter 12 inch, length 134 km' (خط السويس / مسطرد قطر 12 بوصة بطول 134 كم) — an exact match to P7332's name/length/diameter (12in, 134km). Independently, an unrelated Arabic petroleum-lines listing (ns1.almerja.com/more.php?idm=281868, not cited by either wiki page) enumerates Egypt's main PPC-operated trunk lines and lists TWO separate 'Suez/Musturad' entries back to back, both 134 km, with DIFFERENT annual capacities: 'khat al-Suez/Musturad, length 134km, annual capacity 2.3 million metric tons' and a second 'Suez Musturad ... 134km, annual capacity 1.8 million metric tons.' This is independent, direct confirmation that Egypt genuinely operates two parallel Suez-Musturad lines of the same length under the same corridor name — matching the roster's own rule of thumb (same name + same length but DIFFERENT diameter/capacity = real parallel lines, not a duplicate). P7337 ('Suez-Musturad Oil Products Pipeline', 18in) separately cites the Ministry of Petroleum 2018-2019 annual report PDF plus almerja.com's OTHER page — a distinct citation trail from P7332's, consistent with two separately-tracked physical assets rather than one row copied under two names. I could not determine from either source which capacity figure (1.8M vs 2.3M t/y) pairs with which diameter (12in vs 18in), so I am not staging a Capacity fill for either row — that stays an open, low-stakes question, not a duplicate risk. EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION: confirmed — this is a real, named, transmission-scale crude-oil trunk line (PPC's oldest line, in continuous use since 1955), correctly classified as PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Oil. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=EGPC (100%) is defensible — the petro-news article states PPC ('the company operating this line since 1955') was chartered by decision of the Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation's board and is 'one of the companies of the Egyptian petroleum sector'; EGPC is the correct parent/state-holding owner even though PPC is the direct operating entity (PPC is not currently populated on the Operator field and could be added as a secondary attribution note, not a correction). SPEC: Length 134 km is corroborated by TWO independent sources (petro-news + almerja) — tier high. Diameter 12in is confirmed only by petro-news — tier medium, single-sourced; I could not find a second source naming the diameter within this pass's search budget (session WebSearch quota was exhausted before I could run a targeted diameter search). REF HEALTH ISSUE: the Status [ref] cell's ONLY current citation (almalnews.com/...) is a confirmed HTTP 404 — the field currently rests on a dead link even though the value itself (operating) is correct and independently supportable via petro-news.com/11234/ (whose 2021 company-profile framing, still live in 2026, treats this line as part of PPC's active, continuously-operated network since 1955). Recommend swapping/adding petro-news.com/11234/ onto the Status [ref] cell rather than leaving a sole dead link. StartLocation (Suez) and EndLocation (Musturad, Al-Qalyubia) are both named explicitly and consistently across petro-news and almerja.

summary: P7332 confirmed real and correctly classified (transmission, Oil, Suez-Musturad, 134km/12in) via 2 independent Arabic sources (petro-news.com + almerja.com); duplicate concern vs P7337 (same name/length, different diameter) RESOLVED as two genuine parallel lines, not a double-count. Caveats only: Status [ref]'s sole citation is a confirmed 404 (recommend swapping to petro-news.com/11234/, already verified live); diameter (12in) remains single-sourced. No UNRESOLVED items; no fills staged (Capacity left blank deliberately — ambiguous which of two almerja capacity figures pairs with 12in vs 18in).
